# SOLID Change Entry Template

Copy this into [`docs/solid-uml-changelog.md`](../solid-uml-changelog.md) for each class diagram change:

```markdown
### <Number>. <Short title>
- **Who:** <Name> (@<GitHub username>)
- **Class(es):** `<ClassA>`, `<ClassB>`
- **What changed:** <Classes added, removed, moved, or re-related; before → after>
- **SOLID principle(s):** <SRP / OCP / LSP / ISP / DIP> – <how the change follows it>
- **How it helped:** <How the code is now easier to change, test, or extend>
```
